name: 세운 실린더 증기 기관(받침대 + 뚜껑이 보이는 실린더 + 크로스헤드 + 누운 플라이휠)
label: steampunk-city/sp-engine

answer.main_body: vertical cylinder steam engine with horizontal flywheel on a base platform
answer.evidence: The standing cylinder shows a clear foreshortened top cap from row 7 to row 14 (8 rows), the base platform shows its horizontal top surface across rows 34-38, and the flywheel is foreshortened as an ellipse viewed from a 3/4 top-down perspective.

answer.main_body: upright cylinder steam engine on base
answer.evidence: The upright cylinder displays a clearly drawn elliptical top lid (rows 8-14, ~6-7 rows tall), the flywheel is foreshortened horizontally, and the main base plinth has a deep visible top deck (rows 26/34-38).

answer.main_body: vertical cylinder steam engine with platform and horizontal flywheel
answer.evidence: The cylinder features a clearly drawn foreshortened top lid measuring about 7 pixel rows (rows 8-14) with an elliptical rivet ring, sitting on a deep platform top surface (rows 27/34 to 38) alongside a horizontally tilted flywheel.

answer.main_body: vertical cylinder steam engine with horizontal flywheel on a plinth
answer.evidence: The vertical cylinder features an elliptical top cap spanning rows 8-14 (7 rows tall) with bolt detailing, the flywheel is foreshortened horizontally (rows 14-33), and the supporting plinth displays a broad top surface (rows 34-39) before dropping to its south face.
